message.content: {"facts": ["The art installation is scheduled to take place from November 2023 to May 2024", "The main purpose and agenda for this art installation is to promote the idea of togetherness and unity among the Chinese Singaporean community", "The art installation should be attractive and engaging to the public, while incorporating a digital or phygital element", "The art installation focuses on celebrating heritage and family by having visitors create a family tree on paper using coloured pens and markers", "After completing their tree, visitors can scan a QR code that will bring up an augmented reality experience that shows their family tree come to life with animated scenes of their ancestors", "This installation focuses on wellness and invites visitors to participate in a physical activity such as yoga or tai chi", "After completing the activity, visitors can scan a QR code that will bring up a virtual reality experience that takes them on a peaceful journey through a beautiful garden or natural environment", "This installation focuses on unity and invites visitors to contribute to a mural by drawing or painting on a canvas", "After completing their contribution, visitors can scan a QR code that will bring up an augmented reality experience that shows their contribution come to life in a digital animation that merges all of the contributions into a cohesive whole", "This installation focuses on youth and invites them to express their creativity by painting or drawing on a wall", "After completing their artwork, visitors can scan a QR code that will bring up an augmented reality experience that allows them to see their artwork come to life in 3D or as an animation", "A giant interactive tree sculpture that encourages visitors to write messages of unity and hope on paper leaves and hang them on the tree", "The tree will also have augmented reality features, allowing visitors to scan the leaves and see them come to life in 3D animations and videos", "An interactive trail featuring physical activities and wellness stations for families to explore together", "Each station will have a QR code that visitors can scan with their phones to access educational videos and information about the benefits of the activity", "A digital and physical time capsule created by and for youths", "Visitors can contribute digital messages, photos, and videos to be included in the capsule, which will be sealed and displayed at the exhibition", "The capsule will also have an augmented reality feature, allowing visitors to see what the capsule might look like when it's opened in the future", "Interactive booths where visitors can record and share their family's stories and memories", "The booths will also have augmented reality features, allowing visitors to see 3D models of objects and artifacts related to their stories", "A large interactive wall featuring images and stories of diverse communities in Singapore", "Visitors can contribute their own stories and photos, and the wall will also have augmented reality features, allowing visitors to see 3D models of the different cultural artifacts and symbols"]}
